import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import process from 'node:process';
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createPluginHost, definePlugin } from '@nodebraid/runtime-cordis';
function contains(root, expected, seen = new Set()) {
    if (Object.is(root, expected))
        return true;
    if (root === null || typeof root !== 'object' || seen.has(root))
        return false;
    seen.add(root);
    const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(root, 'errors');
    return !!descriptor && 'value' in descriptor && Array.isArray(descriptor.value) && descriptor.value.some((child) => contains(child, expected, seen));
}
const output = process.env.NODEBRAID_RUNTIME_RESULTS;
assert.ok(output);
const rows = [];
for (const route of ['installation', 'host'])
    for (const kind of ['ordinary-aggregate', 'throwing-errors-getter']) {
        const originalLeaf = new Error('original resource failure ' + route + '/' + kind);
        const original = new AggregateError([originalLeaf], 'application-owned AggregateError');
        const inspectionFailure = new Error('secondary errors getter failure ' + route);
        let getterReads = 0, receiverCorrect = true;
        if (kind === 'throwing-errors-getter')
            Object.defineProperty(original, 'errors', { configurable: true, get: function () { getterReads++; receiverCorrect &&= this === original; throw inspectionFailure; } });
        const cleanup = [], eventNames = [];
        const host = createPluginHost({ diagnostics: { sink: event => { eventNames.push(event.name); } } });
        const installation = host.install(definePlugin({ name: 'probe-disposal-' + kind, setup(context) { context.own(() => { cleanup.push('early'); }); context.own(() => { cleanup.push('failing'); throw original; }); context.own(() => { cleanup.push('late'); }); } }));
        await installation.whenActive();
        const operation = route === 'installation' ? installation.dispose() : host.dispose();
        assert.equal(route === 'installation' ? installation.dispose() : host.dispose(), operation);
        const outcome = await operation.then(() => ({ ok: true }), error => ({ ok: false, error }));
        assert.equal(outcome.ok, false);
        if (outcome.ok)
            throw new Error('Expected actual resource disposal failure');
        assert.deepEqual(cleanup, ['late', 'failing', 'early']);
        assert.equal(installation.getSnapshot().status, 'disposed');
        const preserved = contains(outcome.error, original), inspectionReturned = contains(outcome.error, inspectionFailure);
        const row = { route, kind, passed: preserved, originalAggregateIdentityPreserved: preserved, secondaryInspectionFailureInReturnedTree: inspectionReturned, rootIsSecondaryFailure: Object.is(outcome.error, inspectionFailure), rootName: outcome.error instanceof Error ? outcome.error.name : typeof outcome.error, rootMessage: outcome.error instanceof Error ? outcome.error.message : String(outcome.error), getterReads, receiverCorrect, cleanupOrder: cleanup, installationState: 'disposed', eventNames };
        rows.push(row);
        writeFileSync(output, JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2) + '\n');
        console.log(JSON.stringify(row));
        const hostAfter = await host.dispose().then(() => ({ ok: true }), error => ({ ok: false, error }));
        if (route === 'host') {
            assert.equal(hostAfter.ok, false);
            if (!hostAfter.ok)
                assert.ok(Object.is(hostAfter.error, outcome.error));
        }
        else
            assert.equal(hostAfter.ok, true);
    }
assert.equal(rows.length, 4);
assert.equal(rows.filter(x => x.passed).length, 4, 'Diagnostic inspection must not replace the original resource failure');
